strings.new: I might want to train a power.
I wanna have a sleep over!
I'm right here I'm right here!
I don't think they're too friendly.
They aren't very nice, are they…
Uh guys… they have the Rejuvenator.
We need to regroup and have a plan.
Come out and play with me.
Three of me could wear his coat.
I don't want him to read from that book again.
He had glasses but he wasn’t nice.
I liked playing with the golem.
She needs to read me a bedtime story.
I want her to read to me every day but not today.
I like you, Paige, sorry you're dead.
I wish I had a sister as cool as her.
She has an hourglass where her face is.
I don't wanna play with Drifter.
He didn't have a happy smile…
I don't want to be hat brothers with him.
I want to be his friend but he's dead.
He thought he was better than me.
I don't know if he's mean but he's definitely not nice.
I think she snuggles with metal.
I like toys.  She likes toys. We could be friends.
He's probably ok with being dead.
He's like a stuffy only instead of fluff he's filled with dead things.
I wonder if his different parts have different dreams.
He's spooky.  But fun spooky.  Until he kills people.  Then he's scary spooky.
I bet he has lots of secrets.
I see her when I sleep.
I guess having a lot of souls doesn't solve all your problems.
I agree, Vindicta. Shoes are stupid.
I wish I could fly like her.
He's so cool.  And dead.  But still cool.
He works at a fancy place that I'm not supposed to be allowed in.
Flying through the air looks fun.
I heard Lash fights bears, which makes me tougher than a bear.
I don't like card tricks.  They all end the same.
My friend once told me that magicians are jerks because they lie for money.
Looks like I made you disappear.
Do the trick where you die again.
I don't know if those two are gonna make it…
Can I go bowling with you later?
I think her cat hissed at me.
You kill people for money.  That's mean.
I don’t want to be eaten by her cat.
I wonder if I can eat the cat.
I don't know why she's playing with a dead hand, that's weird.
I'm worried about his blood pressure.
I don't know much about priests but I don't think they're supposed to shoot people.
He was like a big leprechaun with a gun.
He looked scary but cool scary not monster scary.
He has a name I can't pronounce.
He smells like gunpowder and incense.
I bet Billy could teach me all kinds of fun words.
I probably shouldn't hang out with Billy until I'm older.
I can't tell if Billy is a fun big kid or a mean big kid.
I love naps as much as he loves knives.
Can I hide in your briefcase?
Your coat smells like the sewer.
If your mom isn't nice you can hang out with my mom.
I think Pocket needs a hug.
I want you to be my friend.
One day, I'll ride on your back and it will be awesome.
Can I be an Arroyo too?
I want to hold her umbrella.
I don't think I like people with pointy teeth.
You should design pajamas, those are cooler than dresses.
Thanks for dying and not drinking my blood.
You can be my cool aunt.
I don't know why people hate her.
Don't worry, Vyper, one day I'll have money, then you can mug me.
I hope I get to hang out with her before she gets arrested again.
Goo is fun to play with.
Goo guy seemed fun.  Now he seems dead.
I bet he's mad all the time.
I dunno what that guy's deal is.
I bet he'd be happier after a nap.
I think she wanted to eat me.
I never met someone who's hair smelt like bourbon.
She'll be nicer when she sleeps it off.
I bet her fur feels nice.
She had four arms, that’s weird.
Maybe she'd fight better if her hands weren't in her pockets.
I don't know what degenerate gambler means but it sounds fun.
I didn't like your card trick.
She's like a magician that shoots people instead of doing magic tricks.
I think people would like her more if she stopped trying to stab everybody.
She doesn’t look like a Yamato.
I don't know, guys, you really shouldn't give me responsibilities.
I don't like being the last one alive…
I don’t wanna miss the end.
Wait guys, don't summon the Patron without me!
I'm gonna summon a god, I'm gonna get home, and then I'm gonna take a nap.
I'll see ya later, bye, don't die.
You should be nicer to me.
I just wanted to take a tap.
I don't think this is a good fight.
I don’t wanna pick that fight.
What do we wanna do, what do we wanna do?
I think I'm going to stick with you guys.
Anyone else want to take a nap?
I hope you guys are ready because I'm really tired.
Part of me hopes that after today we'll be friends for life, but if everything goes well I'm going to go home and never see you guys again, so we can be friends that never talk to each other ever.
They say if you snooze you lose, but that's not true because I snooze all the time and look at me now.
I can put them to sleep now.
Let me know when you want them to go to bed.
You weren't nice to me earlier.
Who left those souls lying around?
There are so many places I could nap.
My friends and I will help.
I'm gonna help. Then I'm gonna sleep.  Then I'll help some more.  Maybe.  Unless I want to sleep again.
I summon Patron.  Then I go home.
I want candy.  Or a gun.  Probably candy.  But maybe a gun, I dunno.
I wonder what I can buy now.
I need to see what they have at the store.
I should go by the curiosity shoppe.
I can get something really cool now.
I might want to buy something new.
I'm going to buy the bestest thing ever.
I got to spend these souls.
Time to break open the piggy bank and buy something.
So they got some souls, big deal.
We need to keep this up.
No Patrons needed.  I'll find my way.
My bed is cozy and the outside is mean.
I'm gonna hit 'em with a pillow.
I'm gonna throw my pillow at them because I'm carrying a pillow and that's really all I can throw.
Well I'm not going to throw my candle at them, that would be crazy.
They're good at doing things that I'm too lazy to do.
It's not safe to travel alone.
People can't be mean when they're asleep.
I'm ready to do it again.
So this is what it's like to be tall.
I'm gonna give 'em a bad day
Attack them while they can't heal.
I'm just going to close my eyes for a second…
